module: Configuration constants of the UI router (ui_router): default main route, transition timeouts (flat for Angular/legacy, per phase for the Vue acknowledgment flow), source of the context decorator and default UI values merged into a route's configuration. Pure data module, no function.
notes: Timeout = 3 s: flat forced-end delay for non-phased transitions (Angular/legacy).

PhaseTimeouts (seconds): startupResendInterval = 1.0 (the startup phase resends the route change event at a fixed interval, never expiring, because mod Vue routes may register late), routeCommit = 3.0, mountReady = 3.0, total = 8.0 (emergency cap on the phases after startup; the startup wait does not count toward it).
The phases: startup (waits for routeNavigationStarted), routeCommit (waits for routeChangeComplete), mountReady (waits for routeMounted when a mount acknowledgment is required).
RouteUiDefaults = {uiNav = true}: gamepad/keyboard navigation is enabled unless the route (or its parents) disables it.
MainRoute is "menu" (original value; no use is visible in this file).

MainRoute.desc: Default route when no route is specified: "menu".

Timeout.desc: Delay in seconds (3) before forced end of a non-phased transition (Angular/legacy).

PhaseTimeouts.desc: Phased transition (Vue) timeouts: startupResendInterval, routeCommit, mountReady, total (seconds).

ContextDecoratorDefaultSource.desc: Default source of the context decorator: "core_gamestate.gameStateDecorator".

ShowContextDecoratorInBreadcrumbs.desc: false: the context decorator is not shown by default in the breadcrumb.

RouteUiDefaults.desc: Default UI values added to the route configuration if it does not define them: {uiNav = true}.
